name: SSF 克隆中心
title: CLONING CENTER
fixed: 入口、顶盖及固定边框：乳白 #FEE4D9
竖向背架和固定主体：米砂 #D5C09C
原有枪管/机构/支承/电缆/工作面/深槽：深灰 #2C3735，保持各模型既有分件
team: 深队色：舱框、侧护盖及顶口框
function: 顶盖开口内侧固定深灰，不混入橙色
structure: 保留两层成对舱体、吊线、斜入口、上部开口及侧天线。

paint_zones.mechanisms: 连接软管、舱端凹口与机构：深灰

cream_coverage_target.basis: visible model surfaces; excludes background, outline and cast shadow

style.new_lines: Freestyle contour/border/major crease on original mesh; no added outline geometry

paint_contract.shading: Three cel-shading levels are separate from the two team base paint colors.
paint_contract.fixed_function_policy: Only existing function locations and palette colors; shield top lights are team-controlled.

geometry_contract: Existing source mesh/source views remain authoritative for geometry, assembly, animations and LOD. Generated sheets are 2D color references, not measured manufacturing drawings or Blender output.
